title: RegistryObject
description: The universal base shape EVERY item inside EVERY registry inherits — a Model, API, Provider, Template, Dataset, Adapter, Policy, Prompt, Validator, Benchmark all share this shape. This is what lets one universal interface (Registry<T>) and one universal dashboard work across 55+ registries. ANTI-FRAGMENTATION: this is the single source of truth for the cross-registry object shape (owner's #1 risk). serves_truth=false — a registry object is a pointer/score/shape, never a truth claim (the verification rail disposes truth).

id.description: stable, hash-suffixed id (never truncation-only; version lives in metadata, never in the id)

type.description: the registry this object belongs to (e.g. model, provider, prompt, validator, benchmark)

versions.description: version history (lossless; version in metadata, not the name)

metrics.description: measured per-registry metrics (accuracy, latency, determinism, cost…) — evidence, not authority
